case_number: 2025 INSC 6; Civil Appeal No. of 2025 (@ SLP (C) No. 29302 of 2019)

parties.petitioner: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Co. Ltd.

summary: Motor accident compensation claim; standard: preponderance of probability, not beyond reasonable doubt; police records including FIR and chargesheet admissible to establish negligence; concurrent findings of Tribunal and High Court on rash/negligent driving upheld; appellant's contention of fraudulent police collusion unsubstantiated; dismissal of appeal affirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding Tribunal award sustained.
